cube-xl.metaTitle: Cube XL, crystal-clear ice cube | Ice Please Morocco
paras: Crystal-clear ice in a cube format, ideal for spirits served on the rocks and cocktails served in rocks glasses.
Its slow melt preserves the balance of the drink while adding an elegant visual touch.
specs: Made-to-measure formats to suit your glassware

ice-stick.metaTitle: Ice Stick, long crystal-clear ice | Ice Please Morocco
paras: Long, crystal-clear ice in a rectangular format, ideal for Collins, highball and long-drink glasses.
Its shape fills the glass with a single piece of ice, limiting the gaps between pieces and reducing the contact surface with the drink.
The result: slower melting, better bubble retention and a drink that stays cool for longer.
Ideal for sparkling drinks, gin and tonics, Japanese highballs and refreshing cocktails.

moon-ball.metaTitle: Moon Ball, spherical ice | Ice Please Morocco
paras: Crystal-clear ice in a spherical format, ideal for spirits served on the rocks and crafted cocktails.
Thanks to its small contact surface, the Moon Ball melts more slowly and limits dilution, preserving the aromas and balance of the drink for longer.
Perfect for whisky on the rocks, premium cocktails, balloon glasses and champagne coupes.

custom-ice.metaTitle: Custom Ice, personalised ice | Ice Please Morocco
paras: Create a unique ice with personalised pieces, designed to add a distinctive touch to your cocktails, signature drinks or event presentations.
Our Custom Ice formats can embed visual elements directly in the ice: fruit, edible flowers, aromatic herbs, logos, colours or other items chosen to suit your needs.
An ideal solution for venues, brands and events that want to offer a tailor-made, memorable experience that fits their universe perfectly.
specs: Fruit, edible flowers, aromatic herbs, logos, colours or other items

paras: Crystal-clear, solid ice cubes of superior size. Designed to deliver regular, dense ice suited to the demands of professional service.
Their generous 36 g size means better hold in the glass, slower melting than a standard ice cube and a neater presentation for everyday drinks.
Ideal for cocktails, soft drinks, spirits, ice buckets and high-volume service.

ice-slab.metaTitle: Ice slab for buffets and seafood displays | Ice Please Morocco
paras: A large, transparent slab of ice made to present seafood, fish and cold buffets and keep them chilled.
Its slow melt keeps the food at a good temperature throughout the service, with a spectacular presentation.
Ideal for receptions, events and caterers. Contact us to talk about what you need.

crushed-ice.metaTitle: Premium crushed ice | Ice Please Morocco
paras: Premium crushed ice, ideal for refreshing cocktails, frozen drinks and presentations that call for a finer, more generous texture.
Its fragmented form chills drinks quickly while adding volume and a polished visual finish to the service.
Perfect for mojitos, caipirinhas, juleps, tropical cocktails, soft drinks and event use.

dry-ice.metaTitle: Premium dry ice | Ice Please Morocco
paras: Premium dry ice, ideal for creating a spectacular smoke effect when serving cocktails, signature drinks, event presentations or bar staging.
It brings strong visual impact and a distinctive experience, while keeping certain products at very low temperatures as needed.
Suited to bars, hotels, restaurants, events, caterers and brand activations looking to add a premium visual dimension to their service.

ice-stamp.metaTitle: Brass Ice Stamps | Ice Please Morocco
paras: Personalise your ice with a unique mark, available as an individual stamp or an imprint tray.
Made of brass, our Ice Stamps let you imprint your logo, symbol or signature directly on the ice, adding a premium finish to your cocktails and spirits.
The stamp format is ideal for marking on demand, while the tray format lets you mark several pieces at once, evenly and efficiently.
A customisable, elegant solution for venues that want to perfect every detail of their service.
